picks.name: Better Sweater Fleece Jacket, Marlow Brown Rib Knit
picks.why: There's still no fleece, so the hiking, lounging and outdoor outfits have no mid-layer. This is a trim full-zip in a ribbed sweater-knit fleece with raglan sleeves, brown with only a small chest label, so it reads more knit than gilet. Wear it over a grey marl tee with the 502s and the Sambas, or under the waxed Ashby on the coast path.

picks.name: Lambswool Saddle Shoulder Crew Neck, Grey
picks.why: The office outfit still needs a knit. This is plain 2-ply lambswool knitted in Hawick, with a fully fashioned saddle shoulder (a neat fit, not boxy) and no branding. At £87 it's well under the knit ceiling. Wear it over a tee with the fawn or navy chinos and the brown Docs.

picks.name: Classic T-Shirt in Grey Marl
picks.why: Tees are still the biggest gap, and every formula from office to travel starts with one. This is a clean mercerised-cotton crew, made in Portugal, in grey marl with no logo, and it sits under any knit or overshirt. It goes with the navy chinos and the Vans Era, or under the grey lambswool crew.
